# rete-rule-engine

> Forward-chaining production rule engine built on a Rete network with a small rule DSL, salience and recency conflict resolution, checked against a naive evaluator Maven artifact `io.github.trysac:rete-rule-engine`, Java package
> `io.github.trysac.rete_rule_engine`, MIT licensed, Java >= 21, standard library only.

- [AGENTS](AGENTS.md): commands, folder map, conventions, limits
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): shape of the library and its public API
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run and extend the tests
